thread:
marta: Quick sync  preparing the release notes for Tues docs deploy. Main checklist: embed deprecation blurb, Dedicated autoscale billing note, fallback routing example, private deploy migration scaffold, and link redirects. Need owners for each snippet.

kevin: I can handle the JS/TS snippet updates. Which streaming examples should be converted to polling?

marta: All quickstart streaming examples in /docs/sdk/js and /docs/changes/examples. Keep the behavior identical but show polling + a note about latency tradeoffs.

jia: I'll take Go auth + Python embedding example. For Python, do we include both the new batch endpoint and the legacy streaming call with a deprecation comment?

marta: Yes. Show the legacy call with a single-line deprecation banner and then the recommended batch code block. Link to the migration checklist.

sam: I'll write the fallback policy config and a short JS snippet showing attempt -> fallback -> UX notice. Draft config: {"policy": "cost_aware", "fallback": ["kestrel-xl","kestrel-m"], "timeout_ms": 500}. Snippet will show a one-line toast if fallback hits.

kevin: For the JS sample, include an example of checking resp.meta.model to show which model served the request. Helps QA.

claire: Product asks for a single line about Dedicated autoscale billing change: "Autoscale pools can now be configured with burst buckets; bursts consume burst credits billed at the burst rate." Flagged for finance review.

oliver: Infra note: some Dedicated pools hit a warm-start regression overnight; p95 increased ~40ms in a small cohort. Add to Known Issues with "investigating" status and link to incident channel.

release-bot: Draft release notes page scaffolded at /docs/releases/2026-03-24-relnotes-dryrun. PR #4859 created.

marta: Link sweep: kevin, can you run anchor check across /docs/changes and /docs/sdk after your PR? We found one broken anchor on the rollout guide yesterday.

kevin: Yep will run the script and include redirects where needed. I'll add a tiny GH Action that validates anchors on push.

jia: For the Go snippet, do we prefer presenting token-based auth first or the KMS wrapper? I can show token for quickstart and a KMS example labelled "production".

marta: That works. Keep examples minimal. Add a short "how to run" under each snippet: npm/pip/go module install + env var + expected JSON keys.

sam: Docs QA checklist (draft): install latest SDKs, set REDWOOD_API_KEY, run example, confirm output JSON contains model/request_id/status, and verify no console errors. Add a final step: run examples in CI matrix for mac/linux.

kevin: ETA: JS by EOD. jia and sam aim for tomorrow AM. Claire/Oliver can review product/infra copy before merge.

marta: Perfect. I'll assemble the release blurb and the known-issues paragraph and push a docs relnotes draft. Please add :eyes: on the PR when ready.

release-bot: Reminder: docs relnotes checklist due in 10 hours.

marta: Thanks everyone. I'll drop the draft link here once it's up.
